description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs.

The Facilities Technician supports the daily operations, maintenance, and safety of the organization’s physical workspace while also managing shipping and receiving activities.

lists.content:
• Perform routine and preventive maintenance on building systems, including plumbing, carpentry, HVAC, electrical, and mechanical systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues and complete repairs using sound judgment, technical skill, and personal initiative.

additional:
Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents.

The base salary range for this position is between $75,000 - $100,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs.

We are seeking a Global Event Marketing Manager who will create brand awareness, generate leads, and secure speaking opportunities for Atom at industry and corporate events.

lists.content: • Event Strategy: Lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of Atom Computing’s presence at premier quantum industry conferences.

additional: The base salary range for this position is between $125,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience.

description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs.

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help design and build the high-performance control systems that drive our next-generation quantum computing platforms.

This role is required to be in the office in Boulder or Austin at least 3 days per week.

lists.content:
• Build and test embedded firmware and software powering high-speed software defined radios, imaging pipelines, and precision scientific instrumentation.
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate using Rust, Python, C/C++, and CUDA.

additional: The base salary range for this position is between $165,000 - $200,000, commensurate with experience.
